{{redirect|Cara|the [[fossil]] reviver in [[Galar]]|Cara Liss}} {{redirect|Kane|the [[character of the day]] from [[AG057|Going for a Spinda]]|Kain}} [[File:Izzy and Cara.png|thumb|250px|Cara and Izzy]] '''Izzy''' (Japanese: '''飯野イイゾー''' ''Iizō Iino'') and '''Cara''' (Japanese: '''飯野カネ''' ''Kane Iino'') are recurring characters in {{aniseries|DP}}. They are residents of [[Twinleaf Town]] as well as {{an|Dawn}}'s neighbors. ==History== Izzy and Cara first appeared in ''[[DP138|Strategy Begins at Home!]]''. They, alongside [[Johanna]] and [[Sayer]], helped organize the [[Twinleaf Festival]]. However, their differing personalities only added pressure and confusion to the festival's planning. They reappeared in ''[[DP139|A Faux Oak Finish!]]'', where it was revealed that they are fans of {{an|Professor Oak}}. However, they and Johanna confused [[James]] for the real Professor Oak. They reappeared again in ''[[DP140|Historical Mystery Tour!]]'', where they were enjoying the Twinleaf Festival. Izzy and Cara reappeared in ''[[DP141|Challenging A Towering Figure!]]'', where they served as judges for the [[Festival Battle Challenge]]. Their latest appearance was in [[DPS01]], where they greeted {{an|Dawn}} upon her return and gave her some vegetables. They are then seen bidding Dawn farewell as she sets off on her journey to [[Hoenn]]. ==Character== Izzy and Cara are a generous couple that often give back to their community. The pair are prone to infighting because of their differing personalities, with Cara generally being more sceptical and worried while Izzy was agreeable and happy. They often required someone else to settle their arguments, which proved frustrating for both [[Johanna]] and [[Sayer]] during the [[Twinleaf Festival]]. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=三宅健太 ''[[Kenta Miyake]]'' (Iizō)
